Streaming chat completion via the Google Vertex AI provider using the vertex_ai/ prefix — verifies SSE chunks from the Gemini streaming endpoint are yielded and assembled correctly

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chatStream({ maxTokens: 32, messages: [{ content: "Count to three, one word per response.", role: "user" }], model: "vertex_ai/gemini-2.0-flash", stream: true });
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
